name: Schülp bei Rendsburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schülp bei Rendsburg (a yellow harrow above white wavy bars and a yellow base on red).
history: Municipal flag of Schülp b. Rendsburg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schülp arms — harrow, wavy bars and base on red
